fact.thing: extra yearly fee on $100,000, bank balanced fund vs one all-in-one ETF
fact.box: RBC Select Balanced Portfolio Series A vs Vanguard Balanced ETF Portfolio (VBAL)
fact.claim: RBC Select Balanced Portfolio Series A, a balanced fund sold through a big bank, has an MER of 1.94%. Vanguard's all-in-one balanced ETF, VBAL, has an MER of 0.22%. On $100,000 that works out to about $1,940 a year against $220, a gap of about $1,720. The fund's MER pays for advice through the bank, while the ETF comes with no advice and you buy it yourself in a brokerage account. This compares one fund with one ETF and is not an average of all bank funds.
